stats
read   80123456
uread  80123456
map    80400000 00001000 w          # a 4 KiB page inside a superpage
unmap  80400000
mapbig 10000000 00c00000 wu
mapbig 10123000 01000000 wu         # the same 4 MiB again
uwrite 103fffff
reset
matrix 10000000 512 col             # L17's worst case, on one superpage
stats
